about_description: ZRO is a precision ballistic calculator for long-range shooting sports. It computes bullet trajectories, generates dope cards, and provides a scope reticle view for field use.
about_open_source_desc: ZRO is open source software, released under the MIT License. View the source code and contribute on GitHub.
about_js_ballistics_desc: Ballistic calculations are powered by the js-ballistics open-source library.
privacy_no_data_desc: The app sends nothing you enter anywhere. There is no account, no analytics and no tracking. All calculations run on your device.
privacy_storage_desc: The app keeps these in the local storage of the browser or app, on this device only:
privacy_storage_profiles: Your profiles, and which one is active
privacy_storage_inputs: The values last entered in the ballistic calculator, scope view, trajectory validation, compare trajectories and MPBR
privacy_storage_dark_mode: Your dark mode choice, once you change it
privacy_storage_language: Your language choice, once you pick one
privacy_storage_keep: They stay until you clear the site data in your browser or uninstall the app. They are not encrypted, not synced and not backed up. The app sets no cookies. A language cookie set by earlier versions is deleted when the app starts.
privacy_web_desc: On the web, the server that hosts the app receives each request for its files, like any web server. It sees your IP address, the files requested and your browser type. What the host logs, and for how long, is not known to the app. The desktop and mobile apps load their files from the device.
privacy_offline_desc: The desktop and mobile apps contain all their files and work offline. The web version needs a connection to load. It has no offline mode, and charts and dope cards load extra code when you open them, so they may not load without a connection.
privacy_store_desc: Basic usage statistics may be collected by the app store platform (Google Play Store, Apple App Store) as part of their standard analytics.

validation_min: Enter a number of at least {min}
validation_range_below_max: Enter a number from {min} to under {max} {unit}
error_page_message: The page you are looking for does not exist.
ballistic_step_min: Enter a step of at least {min} {unit}
ballistic_step_max: Enter a step of at most {max} {unit}, the max distance
ballistic_altitude_too_low: The altitude is too low for this shot: the calculation stops when the bullet goes below {min} {unit}.
ballistic_pressure_hint: As given in weather reports. The app corrects it for the altitude above.
ballistic_air_too_thin: This air is too thin and humid to calculate. Check the pressure, temperature and humidity.
ballistic_no_profile: No active profile. Go to Profiles to activate one.
ballistic_no_result: Cannot compute — check profile and conditions.
mpbr_target_size_hint: Vital zone diameter — bullet must stay within this zone
mpbr_hint: Enter target size and click Calculate
mpbr_no_profile: No active profile. Go to Profiles to activate one.
mpbr_no_result: Cannot compute MPBR — check profile data and target size.
mpbr_about_definition: Maximum Point Blank Range is the farthest distance at which you can aim dead-center and still hit a target of a given size — no hold-over, no dialing.
mpbr_about_zero: Zero at the Optimal Zero distance. The bullet arcs up to the top of the target zone, then falls back through it at the far end.
mpbr_about_beyond: Beyond the MPBR maximum, the bullet drops below the target zone. You must hold over or dial elevation to compensate.
mpbr_about_ideal: Ideal for red dots and iron sights where quick shots leave no time for elevation adjustments.
mpbr_zero_out_of_range: This zero is past {max}, the longest zero the other calculators take, so it cannot be saved to the profile.
traj_val_range_hint: Distance at which you observed the bullet impact
traj_val_measure_hint_angle: Dial-up correction observed at range (bullet below line of sight)
traj_val_measure_hint_angle_above: Dial-down correction observed at range (bullet above line of sight)
traj_val_measure_hint_distance_above: Bullet height above line of sight measured at range
traj_val_above_los_notice: With this profile the bullet is above the line of sight at this range. If you measured it above, choose Above.
traj_val_no_profile: No active profile. Go to Profiles to activate one.
traj_val_hint: Enter an observation to validate the trajectory
traj_val_no_result: No solution: this observation cannot be reached with the current profile. Check the observed value, the above/below choice, and the profile's zero distance and optic height.
traj_val_timeout: Search stopped: it ran out of time before finding an answer, so this observation may still be reachable. A very long zero distance is the usual cause.
traj_val_range_error: Range must be greater than zero distance

compare_zero_no_result: No trajectory with this zero distance — check the zero and the profile.
